ai_request_result.name: ai_request_result
ai_request_result.value: ("ai_summary_request"."status"='pending' and "ai_summary_request"."summary" is null and "ai_summary_request"."finished_at" is null) or ("ai_summary_request"."status"='failed' and "ai_summary_request"."summary" is null and "ai_summary_request"."finished_at" is not null and "ai_summary_request"."finished_at" >= "ai_summary_request"."created_at") or ("ai_summary_request"."status"='completed' and "ai_summary_request"."summary" is not null and length(trim("ai_summary_request"."summary")) between 1 and 1500 and "ai_summary_request"."finished_at" is not null and "ai_summary_request"."finished_at" >= "ai_summary_request"."created_at")

ai_request_review.name: ai_request_review
ai_request_review.value: ("ai_summary_request"."reviewed_at" is null and "ai_summary_request"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) or ("ai_summary_request"."status"='completed' and "ai_summary_request"."reviewed_at" is not null and "ai_summary_request"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "ai_summary_request"."reviewed_at" >= "ai_summary_request"."finished_at")

incident_assignment.name: incident_assignment
incident_assignment.value: ("incident"."status" = 'Not assigned' and "incident"."dispatcher_user_id" is null and "incident"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("incident"."status" <> 'Not assigned' and "incident"."dispatcher_user_id" is not null and "incident"."confirmed_at" is not null)

incident_resolution.name: incident_resolution
incident_resolution.value: ("incident"."status" = 'Resolved' and "incident"."ended_at" is not null and "incident"."ended_at" >= "incident"."created_at") or ("incident"."status" <> 'Resolved' and "incident"."ended_at" is null)

cancellation_review.name: cancellation_review
cancellation_review.value: ("incident_cancellation"."decision" = 'pending' and "incident_cancellation"."reviewed_at" is null and "incident_cancellation"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) or ("incident_cancellation"."decision" <> 'pending' and "incident_cancellation"."reviewed_at" is not null and "incident_cancellation"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "incident_cancellation"."reviewed_at" >= "incident_cancellation"."created_at")

profile_names.name: profile_names
profile_names.value: length(trim("user_profile"."first_name")) between 1 and 100 and length(trim("user_profile"."last_name")) between 1 and 100

report_review_pair.name: report_review_pair
report_review_pair.value: ("report"."reviewed_at" is null and "report"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) or ("report"."reviewed_at" is not null and "report"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null)
